definitions.explanation: A question word asking for the reason or cause of something. Slightly more formal than どうして.

examples.japanese: なぜ{遅|おく}れたのですか？
なぜ{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}しているのですか？

notes:
One of the question words for asking reasons. Compare: どうして (casual, why/how come), なぜ (neutral/slightly formal), なにゆえ (literary/very formal).

Related:
- なぜか (for some reason)
- なぜなら (because).
